lines.text: He says his darling is as lovely as Jerusalem and asks her to turn her eyes away.
He compares her hair to goats streaming down from Hermon, her teeth to sheep, and her brow to pomegranate.
There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, but his dove is unique, the favorite of her mother.
The maidens call her blessed, and a question asks who shines like the dawn, fair as the moon.
The speaker went down to the almond grove to see the blossoms, and desire set him among royal chariots.
